item.title: Will my personal information be shared with other organizations?
item.description: Will my personal information be shared with other organizations? cwadmin Tue, 08/19/2025 - 11:08 Will my personal information be shared with other organizations? No. The ETV Endowment will not sell, rent, barter, share or give its membership donor list to any other entity or individual. See our donor privacy policy. Donating
